purpose: 12 independent evidence gates after Work finishes, without fabricated DONE or worker liveness

gates.name: Private Input ACK
gates.proof: Browser sends innocent user input; private store write returns capture_id/revision; independently read same input after reload; no public secret

gates.name: No Worker Yet
gates.proof: With zero workers assigned, message remains durable PENDING; no queued=true without private receipt

gates.name: Real Admission
gates.proof: Known compatible worker gets actual Work Graph/Worker Bus claim/lease; no shell assumed live from UI

gates.name: Durable RETURN
gates.proof: Claimed worker produces actual material artifact, checks and immutable durable return

gates.name: Same Page Feed
gates.proof: Result appears on original semantic page, unread/seen correct, stored response survives reload

gates.name: Fresh Session
gates.proof: New chat/session without pasted prior transcript rehydrates user intent, decisions, blocked tasks and latest result

gates.name: Dedup & Recovery
gates.proof: Duplicate submit, retry, crash before/after ACK, late/out-of-generation RETURN do not double execute or erase

gates.name: Privacy/Auth
gates.proof: RLS/auth/access control, secrets/transcripts never in public GitHub/browser URLs; mobile session safe

gates.name: Real Telemetry
gates.proof: Measure ACK, assignment, first work, return/feed elapsed; real lease/current ping, throughput/retries/conflicts; stale displayed honestly; no excessive writes

gates.name: Minimal Configurable UX
gates.proof: Only user-selected widgets visible; motor/nafta summary optional, deep stats hidden by default; no fake numbers

gates.name: Preservation & Visual Reference
gates.proof: V15 behavior/mobile/widget lifecycle preserved; no final aesthetic/design changes until user reference photos

gates.name: Promotion And Rollback
gates.proof: Independent evidence for SOURCE, TESTED, VERIFIED, CURRENT, SERVED; exact published bytes, rollback and next work

human_report_required: User will paste Work completion report. Check every referenced SHA/URL/receipt before marking a gate PASS.
